effectSummary.ko: 6m 안에 쇠뇌 하나를 6초간 설치하고 1초마다 9m 안의 감지한 적에게 D35% 물리 추가 피해를 줍니다. 최근 2초 안에 본체 사격이 맞힌 적을 서로 60도 이상 다른 사선에서 쏘면 D45%를 더합니다. 교차 사선과 표식 대상을 우선하며 최대 6회 사격합니다. 추가 사격은 발동을 재생산하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Place one ballista within 6m for 6s. Each second, fire at a perceived enemy within 9m for D35% secondary physical damage. Add D45% when firing at an enemy hit by the hero within 2s from a firing angle at least 60 degrees apart. Prefer crossfire, then marked targets, up to 6 shots. Secondary shots trigger no further procs.

productionConcept: A compact gothic portable ballista made from dark wood and worn iron is firing one broad silver bolt. Three-quarter view, two hefty bow arms and a short stable tripod contained within the silhouette, no floor or scenery.
prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for A15 (Ranger). Main subject: a compact medieval ballista in three-quarter view, two bold green-gold arrows entering one small target from clearly different angles, unmistakable crossed firing lines. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.
